description.value: McLean Mill National Historic Site is a federally designated historic site near Port Alberni on Vancouver Island, preserving a historic steam-powered sawmill. It operates as a museum under the Alberni Heritage organization and draws visitors interested in BC's industrial logging heritage. The site is seasonal, making it a worthwhile destination stop for cyclists touring the Port Alberni valley in summer months.
